nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Next.js root layout component. Configures Inter and JetBrains Mono Google fonts, imports global CSS, and wraps all page content in the Providers client component. Defines app metadata (title, description) and viewport settings.

nodes.name: Providers
nodes.summary: Client-side provider wrapper that composes SessionProvider (next-auth), VoiceChatProvider, VoiceChatButton, and Toaster into a single tree. Consumed by RootLayout to bootstrap all client-side providers.

nodes.name: CodeZonePage
nodes.summary: Main page implementing a social feed / community platform with cinematic dark UI. Supports authenticated post creation, like/comment/share interactions, and feed filtering (featured, rising, following). Uses a 'signal' themed aesthetic with nebula backgrounds, iridescent effects, and animated loaders.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining the design system. Declares @theme CSS variables for all color tokens (light and dark modes), border radii, and sidebar/chart palettes. Includes custom keyframe animations (fadeInUp, shimmer, cursorPulse, bracketGlow, slideInScale, etc.) and Monaco editor UI enhancements (animated selections, bracket matching, suggest widgets, minimap shadows).

nodes.name: middleware
nodes.summary: Next.js edge middleware for route-level authentication. Checks JWT tokens via next-auth; returns 401 JSON for unauthenticated API requests and redirects unauthenticated page requests to /auth/login. Only protects /api/execute and /api/submissions/:path* routes.

nodes.name: auth
nodes.summary: NextAuth v5 configuration with multiple authentication strategies: Credentials (email + password via bcrypt), Google OAuth, and GitHub OAuth (conditionally enabled via env vars). Uses PrismaAdapter for session persistence and JWT for session strategy. Extends the Session type to include id, username, and image. Auto-generates usernames for OAuth sign-ups with collision handling.

nodes.name: prisma
nodes.summary: Singleton Prisma client with build-time safety. Conditionally constructs PrismaPg adapter only when DATABASE_URL is present to prevent build crashes on Vercel. Reuses the client across hot-reloads in development via globalForPrisma.

nodes.name: admin
nodes.summary: Admin role verification helper. Parses ADMIN_EMAILS from env (comma-separated), compares against the current session email, and returns an {ok, session} discriminated union for use in admin API routes.

nodes.name: httpErrors
nodes.summary: Error mapping utilities that convert Prisma known errors to HTTP status codes. Handles P2002 (unique constraint -> 409), P2025 (not found -> 404), and defaults other errors to 400.

nodes.name: utils
nodes.summary: Tiny utility providing a cn() function that merges clsx conditional classes and tailwind-merge for deduplicating Tailwind utility conflicts.

nodes.name: debug
nodes.summary: Comprehensive debug logging system for AlgoMentor with color-coded ANSI output across 8 subsystems (MENTOR, CACHE, AI, STAGE, EMBED, DB, RATE, PATTERN). Includes performance timers (startTimer, timeAsync), interaction tracing (traceInteraction), and in-memory log history with filtering, stats, and clear capabilities. Controlled by DEBUG or NODE_ENV=development env vars.

nodes.name: startup
nodes.summary: Server startup health check system. Validates required/optional environment variables, tests database and Redis connectivity, warms up the embedding model, and performs a cache warmup. Provides runStartupChecks() for initialization and getHealthStatus() for runtime health reporting (ok/degraded/down). Also includes async health probes for Groq API, embedding model, and DB.

nodes.name: rateLimit
nodes.summary: Distributed rate limiting with sliding window algorithm. Primary backend uses Redis sorted sets; falls back to in-memory Map for development. Exposes checkRateLimit() for AI calls (20/hour), checkHintLimit() per problem (max 4 hints), checkPlanLimit() for FREE users (5 problems/day), plus increment/reset/status primitives and a generic slidingWindowLimit function.

nodes.name: api-key-pool
nodes.summary: API key management pool with round-robin rotation and per-key cooldown. Supports multiple Groq and OpenRouter API keys from env vars (GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY_1...N, etc.). Implements health tracking, exponential cooldown on 429/5xx errors, automatic recovery, and status reporting via poolStatus() and allPoolStatuses().

nodes.name: request-coalesce
nodes.summary: Request deduplication utility. Prevents redundant concurrent identical async calls by tracking in-flight promises in a Map. When a duplicate key arrives, it awaits the existing promise instead of executing a new call. Used to coalesce identical AI queries from multiple users.

nodes.name: Navbar
nodes.summary: Top navigation bar with brand link ('Aether AI'), page navigation links (Home, Problems, Leaderboard, Discussions), and user avatar. Uses next-auth session data for profile display.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Collapsible left sidebar navigation with icon-only default view that expands on hover. Contains links to Workbench (home), Architect (problems), Leaderboard, and Settings. Includes branding element with 'Aether' name.

nodes.name: ApiOnboardingDialog
nodes.summary: Multi-step onboarding dialog for AI provider configuration. Supports 6 providers: Server Default, Google AI (Gemini), Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama (local). Each provider has a welcome screen, selection card with pricing/rating badges, and a configuration form for API keys. Uses sonner toasts for success/error feedback. Saves settings via PATCH /api/settings/ai.

nodes.name: AuthRequiredDialog
nodes.summary: Authentication required dialog prompting users to sign in. Offers three sign-in options: default credentials, Google OAuth, and GitHub OAuth. Includes a link to the registration page for new users.

nodes.name: Markdown
nodes.summary: Minimal custom Markdown renderer with no external dependencies. Supports headings (h1-h3), paragraphs, and fenced code blocks with language tags. Uses HTML escaping for security and renders via dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Optimized with React.useMemo.

nodes.name: MentorChat
nodes.summary: AI mentor chat interface for coding problems. Accepts problem metadata (ID, title, statement, constraints, test cases) and user code as props. Sends messages to /api/mentor with optional pre-flight syntax checking via /api/syntax-check. Displays conversation history with loading indicators and error handling.

nodes.name: VoiceChat
nodes.summary: Full voice chat implementation using Web Speech API. Features speech recognition (push-to-talk and continuous modes), speech synthesis for AI response playback, and a minimizable floating card UI. Connects to /api/voice-chat endpoint. Supports browser compatibility detection with alerts for unsupported browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari supported).

nodes.name: VoiceChatButton
nodes.summary: Floating action button that opens the VoiceChat panel. Uses VoiceChat context to toggle visibility. Positioned at bottom-right of the screen with a tooltip. Hidden when the voice chat panel is already open.

nodes.name: VoiceChatProvider
nodes.summary: React context provider for voice chat state management. Exposes isOpen, openChat, closeChat, and toggleChat via useVoiceChat hook. Manages isOpen and isMinimized state. Conditionally renders VoiceChat as a child when open.

nodes.name: shadcn/ui config
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui component configuration specifying New York style, RSC mode, TSX support, Tailwind CSS integration, Lucide icon library, and path aliases (@/components, @/components/ui, @/lib, @/hooks with CSS vars).

nodes.name: Providers
nodes.summary: Client provider wrapper composing SessionProvider, VoiceChatProvider, VoiceChatButton, and Toaster into a single render tree.

nodes.name: CodeZonePage
nodes.summary: Main page component rendering the social feed. Fetches posts via API, handles post creation, displays a cinematic UI with feed filters, user avatars, timestamps, like/comment/share buttons, and code snippet rendering.

nodes.name: getTimeAgo
nodes.summary: Relative time formatter that returns human-readable time strings ('Signal Live' for <60s, 'Xm', or 'Xh').

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Root layout function rendering the HTML shell with configured font variables and dark background, wrapping children in Providers.

nodes.name: middleware
nodes.summary: Edge middleware function that validates JWT authentication tokens. Returns 401 JSON for unauthenticated API requests and redirects page requests to /auth/login with callback URL preservation.

nodes.name: normalizeBaseUsername
nodes.summary: Sanitizes a username string by trimming, lowercasing, replacing spaces with underscores, and removing non-alphanumeric characters except underscores.

nodes.name: ensureOAuthUsername
nodes.summary: Auto-generates a username for OAuth users who lack one. Tries the base username first, then appends random suffixes on collision. Falls back to a unique username using the user ID as suffix.

nodes.name: createPrismaClient
nodes.summary: Constructs a PrismaClient, optionally with PrismaPg adapter when DATABASE_URL is available. Falls back to default client construction when the connection string is missing (build-time safety).

nodes.name: requireAdmin
nodes.summary: Async function that retrieves the current session, parses admin emails from env, and returns a discriminated union indicating whether the user is an admin.

nodes.name: parseAdminEmails
nodes.summary: Parses a comma-separated ADMIN_EMAILS env var into a normalized array of lowercase emails.

nodes.name: isPrismaKnownError
nodes.summary: Type guard to check if an unknown error is a PrismaClientKnownRequestError.

nodes.name: prismaErrorToHttp
nodes.summary: Maps Prisma error codes to HTTP status codes: P2002->409 (conflict), P2025->404 (not found), default->400 (bad request).

nodes.name: cn
nodes.summary: Combines clsx and tailwind-merge to merge Tailwind class names, resolving conflicts where conflicting utilities overlap.

nodes.name: debug (object)
nodes.summary: Namespace object containing 8 subsystem-specific loggers (mentor, cache, ai, stage, embed, db, rate, pattern). Each logger outputs color-coded, timestamped messages with optional structured data.

nodes.name: startTimer
nodes.summary: Creates a performance timer that logs elapsed time when stopped. Measures using performance.now() and only logs when debug is enabled.

nodes.name: timeAsync
nodes.summary: Wraps an async function to automatically measure and log its execution time via startTimer.

nodes.name: traceInteraction
nodes.summary: Traces the full lifecycle of a mentor interaction, logging start/completion/failure with timing information. Used to instrument the mentor AI request pipeline.

nodes.name: getLogHistory
nodes.summary: Returns recent log entries from in-memory history, filterable by system and limit.

nodes.name: clearLogHistory
nodes.summary: Clears the in-memory log history buffer.

nodes.name: getLogStats
nodes.summary: Returns a count breakdown of log entries by subsystem.

nodes.name: runStartupChecks
nodes.summary: Orchestrates all startup checks: env validation, database connection, Redis connection, embedding warmup, and cache warmup. Times the entire process and logs a formatted summary.

nodes.name: getHealthStatus
nodes.summary: Runtime health check that probes all subsystems (DB, Redis, Groq, embeddings, cache) in parallel and determines overall status as ok, degraded, or down.

nodes.name: slidingWindowLimit
nodes.summary: Core sliding window rate limit implementation. Uses Redis sorted sets when available (with pipeline for atomicity); falls back to in-memory Map when Redis is absent. Returns allowed/remaining/resetAt/retryAfterMs.

nodes.name: checkRateLimit
nodes.summary: Public function to check AI call rate limits. Allows 20 AI calls per user per hour with a descriptive remaining/limited message.

nodes.name: checkHintLimit
nodes.summary: Checks hint limits per problem/user via DB session currentRung (max 4 hints). Fails open on DB errors.

nodes.name: checkPlanLimit
nodes.summary: Enforces daily problem limits for FREE plan users (5/day). PRO and TEAM plans are unlimited. Counts distinct problems via MentorSession queries. Fails open on DB errors.

nodes.name: getKeyFromPool
nodes.summary: Gets the next healthy API key via round-robin selection. Creates pool from env on first call. Recovers keys whose cooldown has expired. Returns least-cooled-down key as last resort when all keys are in cooldown.

nodes.name: reportKeyFailure
nodes.summary: Reports an API key failure. Applies incremental cooldown (429: 60s/120s/180s/240s, 5xx: 30s). Marks key unhealthy after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_FAILURES failures.

nodes.name: poolStatus
nodes.summary: Returns health status of all keys in a provider pool, including success rates, cooldown status, and failure counts.

nodes.name: allPoolStatuses
nodes.summary: Returns pool status for all providers (groq, openrouter).

nodes.name: coalesce
nodes.summary: Executes an async function with request deduplication. Returns true if caller should execute (new request), false if it was deduplicated and another in-flight request provided the result.

nodes.name: ApiOnboardingDialog
nodes.summary: Multi-step dialog (welcome -> provider selection -> configuration) for AI provider setup. Supports server default, Google AI, Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama. Saves configuration via PATCH /api/settings/ai with sonner toast feedback.

nodes.name: AuthRequiredDialog
nodes.summary: Dialog prompting unauthenticated users to sign in via credentials, Google, or GitHub OAuth. Links to registration page.

nodes.name: Markdown
nodes.summary: Renders a subset of Markdown (headings h1-h3, paragraphs, fenced code blocks) to sanitized HTML using React.useMemo for performance optimization.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes HTML special characters (&, <, >, ", ') for XSS prevention when rendering Markdown to HTML.

nodes.name: MentorChat
nodes.summary: AI mentor chat UI. Sends user messages to /api/mentor with problem context, test cases, and optionally pre-checked syntax errors from /api/syntax-check. Displays conversation with loading states.

nodes.name: VoiceChat
nodes.summary: Voice chat panel with speech recognition and synthesis. Handles push-to-talk, continuous listening modes, auto-play of AI responses, minimize/expand states, and fallback alerts for unsupported browsers. Communicates with /api/voice-chat.

nodes.name: VoiceChatButton
nodes.summary: Floating tooltip-triggered button that opens/closes the VoiceChat panel via context.

nodes.name: VoiceChatProvider
nodes.summary: React context provider managing voice chat open/minimized state. Exposes useVoiceChat hook for consumers.

nodes.name: useVoiceChat
nodes.summary: Hook to access VoiceChat context. Throws if used outside VoiceChatProvider.

nodes.name: Navbar
nodes.summary: Sticky top navigation bar with brand, page links, and user avatar powered by session data.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.summary: Collapsible sidebar with icon navigation that expands on hover for label visibility.
